subject: general
question: The marked price of a television set is ₹35,000. A shopkeeper allows a discount of 22% and gets a profit of 75%. What is the cost price of the television set?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Discount 22% → SP = 78% of MP = 35000 × 0.78 = 27300

Profit 75% → SP = 175% of CP

So CP = SP ÷ 1.75

= 27300 ÷ 1.75 = 15600

**∴ Answer = ₹15600**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Marked Price = 35000, Discount = 22%, Profit = 75%

**Formula used:**

SP = MP × (1 − Discount), SP = CP × (1 + Profit)

**Calculation:**

⇒ SP = 35000 × (78/100) = 27300

⇒ SP = 1.75 × CP

⇒ CP = 27300 ÷ 1.75

⇒ CP = 15600

**∴ The correct answer is ₹15600.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Discount Concept

SP = MP × (1 − Discount/100)

Profit Formula

SP = CP × (1 + Profit/100)

Reverse Calculation

CP = SP ÷ (1 + Profit/100)

Successive Steps

Apply discount first, then profit relation.
